title: Document the signs, not a diagnosis
body: A few clear notes about what you saw, where and when can help a pest-control team prepare for the first conversation without promising a remote diagnosis.

title: Termite and general pest paths are not the same
body: A useful service website keeps termite education and general pest requests separate so homeowners can reach the right conversation faster.

title: Local coverage should be easy to verify
body: A focused service-area section can show where the business works without burying customers in dozens of repetitive location pages.
